notes:
REF-BM-02: Metadata fetching supplies title and description only; favicon and preview image are not collected.
REF-BM-04: URL, title, description, and tags are editable, but there is no distinct note field.
REF-BM-06: Saving an existing URL creates another bookmark without duplicate detection or edit guidance.
REF-BM-07: Cards show title, description, and tags, but use a generated letter tile rather than the page favicon.
REF-BM-10: Tag entry is a plain comma-separated input with no autocomplete.
REF-BM-12: Search covers title, description, URL, and tags, but there is no distinct note content to search.
REF-BM-14: Search treats #tag as ordinary text and stored tag names do not contain the # prefix.
REF-BM-15: Boolean operators and parenthesised search expressions are not parsed.
REF-BM-16: Quoted phrases are not parsed as exact-match searches.
REF-BM-17: Bookmarks have no unread/read-later state.
REF-BM-18: There is no unread-only view.
REF-BM-19: There is no action to mark a bookmark read.
REF-BM-20: There is no multi-selection or bulk-action interface.
REF-BM-21: No action can target all bookmarks in the current filtered collection.
REF-BM-23: There is no markdown note storage or rendering.
REF-BM-24: No local HTML or PDF snapshot is preserved.
REF-BM-25: Internet Archive snapshot creation is not implemented.
REF-BM-29: Saved filter bundles are not implemented.
REF-BM-30: Netscape HTML import is not implemented.
REF-BM-31: Netscape HTML export is not implemented.
REF-BM-32: Display-related personal settings are not implemented.
